answer: Onyx-Chip Bridge, $22 per fake: every identity is bound to one physical onyx secure-enclave chip whose serial is bridged to it in a public registry — one chip, one identity, forever. Each epoch the chip must sign a fresh whisper challenge; an emulated chip fails the manufacturer attestation check and a copied serial burns both identities. A farm needs a real $22 chip per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost $22,000 in hardware plus one chip per identity to ship and register.
